channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Federal judge denies request to block ICE surge in Minnesota
item.description: A federal judge in Minnesota denied a request by the state government and the cities of Minneapolis and St. Paul today to temporarily block a surge of federal immigration agents that has led to three shootings, thousands of arrests and weeks of protests.

item.title: Israeli strikes on Gaza kill over 30, Palestinian health officials say
item.description: Israel pounded Gaza today with some of its most intense airstrikes since the October ceasefire, killing more than 30 people including three girls from one family, in attacks on houses, tents and a police station, Palestinian health officials said.

item.title: Honolulu police seek 3 suspects in restaurant burglary
item.description: Honolulu police say they are looking for three male suspects who burglarized a restaurant in the Waimalu Shopping Center early this morning.

item.title: No. 3 Hawaii outlasts No. 14 Penn State for 7th straight win
item.description: Kainoa Wade tied a career-high with 21 kills and Louis Sakanoko added a season-high 19 kills to lead No. 3 Hawaii to a 25-27, 25-10, 25-15, 38-36 win over No. 14 Penn State today at Rec Hall in University Park, Pa.

item.title: Judge orders release of 5-year-old, whose detention drew outrage
item.description: A federal judge today ordered the release of a 5-year-old boy and his father from immigration custody, condemning their removal from their suburban Minneapolis neighborhood as unconstitutional.

item.title: Human remains found in search for missing man, 19, on Kauai
item.description: Kauai police said the discovery of human remains this afternoon off Kahili Beach in Kilauea are believed to be that of a missing 19-year-old Kapaa man.

item.title: Some U.S. agencies shutter as House sets vote on budget deal
item.description: The U.S. government stumbled into a partial shutdown today while waiting for the House to approve a funding deal President Donald Trump worked out with Democrats following a national uproar over Border Patrol agents’ killing of a U.S. citizen in Minneapolis.

item.title: Fans are so obsessed with ‘KPop Demon Hunters,’ they are learning Korean
item.description: To properly sing along to “Golden,” the inescapable hit song from the movie “KPop Demon Hunters,” it helps to know Korean, which is sprinkled into the lyrics.

item.title: Injured paraglider airlifted from base of cliff on Maui
item.description: A 34-year-old man was injured today while paragliding in Haiku, Maui.

item.title: Police investigate arson case in Mililani
item.description: Police have opened a first-degree arson case for a fire this morning behind a Mililani business.
